analysis:
This batch contains only test changes.

- CoordinatorReconnectPolicyTests.swift (head 1-95, new): unit tests for CoordinatorReconnectPolicy. They check that the backoff resets after a session of 60 s or more, that close code 1012 gives a 0-1 s wait without growing the backoff, and that every other close code, transport close or refused attempt keeps the ExponentialBackoff ranges (0.5...1 up to 15...30).
- NetworkFrameworkCloseCodeTests.swift (head 1-142, new): tests sentCloseCode(content:), which reads a 2-byte big-endian code from the close payload when Network.framework reports noStatusReceived. Short or missing content returns 1005. A contract test drives an NWConnection against MockCoordinator.
- MockCoordinator.swift (head 445-456): dropActiveWebSocket now takes a closeCode and reason; the defaults keep the old 1001 behavior.

No production source is in this batch: CoordinatorClient, CoordinatorReconnectPolicy, CoordinatorSessionEnd and the sentCloseCode extension were not supplied.

Security-relevant contract for integration (TB-002, ADV-003, availability):
- The close-frame payload is a network-controlled input that a peer can forge. Anything on the path that can inject a 1012 close (edge, MITM on a non-TLS path, or a malicious coordinator stand-in) can make the provider reconnect within 0-1 s repeatedly without the backoff growing. That is a possible reconnect-storm or load amplification against the coordinator.
- The tests show 1012 never grows the backoff (line 58-61 loop), so a peer that repeatedly closes with 1012 gets sub-second reconnects indefinitely.
- This is not a provider confidentiality issue. The coordinator controls the 1012 decision, but whether there is any cap or jitter beyond the 0-1 s range depends on unseen runLoop code.

Integration should verify:
- the CoordinatorClient receive-callback parsing, for bounds checks on payload length (the tests suggest safe handling of slices and short data);
- that reconnect does not bypass registration/App Attest re-proof (TB-011, T-053: a new connection must get a fresh challenge or endpoint-resumption proof);
- whether repeated 1012 has any rate bound.

No regression is identifiable from the test-only evidence.
